text:
incident-bot: Paging oncall — prod-us-west-2 inference-gateway elevated 5xx/timeouts (since ~10:22 UTC). Severity: high. auto-alert: error-rate > 7% for 3m.

alice-oncall: on it. brief impact? which customers seeing it?

eva-cs: frank already sent a few tickets — Customer: GoodFoods and FinLens reporting 504s and slow responses around 10:20-10:30. screenshots in zendesk.

frank-support: GoodFoods says batch inference failing (timeouts), FinLens sees partial responses then disconnect. I can share traces if useful.

carla-sre: checking metrics — gateway 503/504s correlate with NAT egress error spikes. CloudMetric: NAT_SnatPortExhaustion% spiked to 99% on nat-gw-02 in az-a.

bob-net: confirming. host nat-gw-02 ephemeral port in_use ~ 64500/65535. hitting allocation ceiling. also seeing >400k simultaneous connections across pool.

dinesh-eng: any recent deploys touching security groups / keepalive?

alice-oncall: negative on deploys in last hour. Last infra change was yesterday.

carla-sre: tcpdumps from inference-gw show lots of SYN retrans and RSTs outbound to customer APIs. snippet:
```
10:24:01 IP inference-gw -> 10.0.0.1:52345 Flags [S], seq 0
10:24:01 IP nat-gw-02 -> 203.0.113.42:52345 Flags [S], seq 0
10:24:05 IP nat-gw-02 -> 203.0.113.42 Flags [R], seq 1
```

bob-net: peering appears stable (BGP not flapping). this looks like port exhaustion on nat-gw-02 not routing problem.

alice-oncall: ok mitigation plan — 1) fail traffic away from nat-gw-02 to nat-gw-backup in same az (route update) 2) enable additional dedicated egress pool in az-b 3) temporarily reduce max_conns per connection from gateway to downstream to free ports faster. can someone take each?

maria-platops: I can do (1) route table swap. preparing runbook commands.

bob-net: I'll own (2) — spinning up 4 extra egress nodes and attaching to egress-load-balancer. should be warm in ~120s.

dinesh-eng: I'll look at connection settings and reduce keepalive to 15s across outbound client pool. patching config in k8s:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  client_keepalive: "15s"
```
kubectl apply -f client-egress-config.yaml -n inference
```

carla-sre: queued rtb change: updating route table rtb-0a1 to point 10.0.0.0/16 -> nat-gw-backup (eni-0b) now.

maria-platops: applied rtb change at 10:35 UTC. propagation looked immediate for new flows.

incident-bot: automation: route-table-update job completed (job-id: rtup-553).

alice-oncall: bob, status on extra egress nodes?

bob-net: +4 nodes healthy behind egress-lb at 10:36. attaching traffic now. port usage per nat: nat-gw-02 dropped to ~18k in_use, nat-gw-backup + new nodes handling surge.

frank-support: Customer GoodFoods confirm errors down from 24% -> 2% within ~5m. :thumbsup:

eva-cs: FinLens reporting latency back to normal. still watching.

carla-sre: error rate dropped to 0.8% cluster-wide. QPS stable. I'm keeping monitors pinned for 30m.

alice-oncall: great. defensive steps: 1) open support ticket to request AWS NAT quota increase (if applicable) 2) longer-term add egress autoscaling rule based on SNAT utilization 3) postmortem owner?

dinesh-eng: I'll own the postmortem — will include root cause analysis and action items (autoscale, keepalive defaults, and add runbook).

maria-platops: I'll file change to make route swap playbook automated with safe rollback.

bob-net: I'll add capacity guardrails for egress pool and a synthetic test to exercise ephemeral consumption.

frank-support: updated GoodFoods and FinLens with mitigation notes and ETA for follow-up (we'll send postmortem).

alice-oncall: customer impact summary for ops post: customers affected: GoodFoods, FinLens; window: 10:20-10:36 UTC; root cause: NAT ephemeral port depletion on nat-gw-02 leading to outbound connection failures; mitigation: route table failover + spin up egress nodes + keepalive change.

incident-bot: Incident updated to RESOLVED (auto) — error-rate below threshold for 15m.

carla-sre: leaving monitors at elevated sensitivity for 2 hours. if we see recurrence, page immediately and revert keepalive change.

dinesh-eng: postmortem draft will be ready EOD. action items assigned in doc.

alice-oncall: good job team — quick coordinated mitigation. :tada: we'll run the postmortem and schedule the egress autoscale work. closing thread after postmortem linked.

frank-support: tagging CS owners for follow-up. :mailbox_with_mail:

maria-platops: documented runbook step used and added runbook id rb-774 to ops playbook.

alice-oncall: closing chat — leaving notes in incident tracker. if anyone sees residual spikes, reopen here.

frank-support: thanks all.
